name: Hallucinations
detailed_description:
How to play the game

Players need to find abnormal places. There are no abnormalities on the first day of the game. Players need to find abnormal places every day. If there are abnormalities, press "E" on the right side of the bed to take medicine, and then press "F" to sleep. If there are no abnormalities, players do not need to take medicine, just press "F" to sleep. If the operation fails, it will return to the first day. You will pass the level successfully after making it to the eighth day.

How many abnormalities are there in the game?

There are 39 abnormalities in the game. Players can continue the game to get all the abnormal points

Can players move independently?

No. Players cannot move, can only move with the camera, and can only interact through "F" and "E" on the keyboard.

Game story

The protagonist in the game is suspected of having a fantasy disorder. Every day he fantasizes that the scene is abnormal. On this day, the protagonist underwent an eight-day examination. If you make it to the eighth day, you will get a report on whether you have a fantasy disorder.

Is the game play time very short?

If it is just to reach the eighth day, then the game play process will be very fast. However, there are 39 anomalies in the game. It takes a certain amount of time to collect all of them.

Game Style

The essence of the game is to find anomalies. Players need to understand what the scene is like when there are no anomalies. If there are changes, they must perform corresponding operations. The game atmosphere is a depressing and terrifying atmosphere.
